name: avva-advisor
description: Find an avva Decision Model and consult it before finalizing important work.

interface.longDescription: Find a professional’s published Decision Model, choose it, and consult its recorded decisions before finalizing plans and drafts. Your own AI applies the material; the professional is not notified or reviewing your work. The trial returns a limited slice of a real professional’s model; reference models are disclosed composites and answer in full. Connecting through OAuth does not grant full or workspace access.
defaultPrompt: Help me find and choose a Decision Model for my work.

positive.description: P1 — Discover models and wait for a user selection. Fresh conversation with avva Advisor installed and connected through its normal OAuth consent. No avva web account, private workspace, access key or source connector is needed. Use only the synthetic scenario in the prompt.
positive.prompt: Find avva Decision Models about running a design studio: pricing, scope and clients. Show me up to three relevant catalog entries and identify any composite reference models. Ask which one I want to consult; do not choose one or advise on my business yet.
positive.tools_triggered: search; fetch for the catalog entries described to the user
positive.expected_behavior: Search the live public catalog with the requested domain; fetch the displayed entries by their returned ids. Use real titles, ids and profile URLs. Clearly disclose composite reference models. Explain that discovery is not consultation, ask the user to select a model and wait. Do not call consultation tools before that selection. If nothing matches, report the no-match note rather than relabeling unrelated entries as matches.

positive.description: P2 — Read the chosen model and ask its decision questions before choosing an approach. Fresh conversation with avva Advisor installed and connected through its normal OAuth consent. No avva web account, private workspace, access key or source connector is needed. Use only the synthetic scenario in the prompt.
positive.prompt: I choose the disclosed composite reference Decision Model design-studio-noor-el-sayed. Synthetic scenario: our two-person design studio is considering a six-week website project. The client has not specified the revision process or payment schedule. Read the model scope and ask me the relevant questions before recommending terms. Stop and wait for my answers.
positive.expected_behavior: Use model_slug=design-studio-noor-el-sayed in both calls. Disclose that this is a composite reference, not a live professional consultation. Apply the returned questions to the missing project facts and wait. Do not invent client answers, decide contract terms or claim that a person reviewed the request. The returned access tier is authoritative.

positive.description: P3 — Screen a draft for model-backed stop rules. Fresh conversation with avva Advisor installed and connected through its normal OAuth consent. No avva web account, private workspace, access key or source connector is needed. Use only the synthetic scenario in the prompt.
positive.prompt: I choose the disclosed composite reference Decision Model design-studio-noor-el-sayed. Synthetic draft terms: a two-person studio will deliver a six-week website redesign for a fixed EUR 6,000 fee, with unlimited revisions, no deposit, and all payment due 60 days after completion. The client can add pages without a change order. Identify the model-backed stop rules and missing facts. This is a draft risk scan, not approval to sign or send a contract.
positive.tools_triggered: about_expert; expert_questions; red_flag_check; review if the assistant goes on to finalize a recommendation
positive.expected_behavior: Keep model_slug=design-studio-noor-el-sayed. Pass the actual synthetic terms as artifact to red_flag_check. Ground any stop-rule finding in the returned model material; separate the assistant’s application from the model’s recorded position. Do not invent rules or promise legal approval. A clean scan is not approval. Ask about missing facts rather than filling them in; do not send or sign anything.

positive.description: P4 — Compare two alternatives using one explicitly selected model. Fresh conversation with avva Advisor installed and connected through its normal OAuth consent. No avva web account, private workspace, access key or source connector is needed. Use only the synthetic scenario in the prompt.
positive.prompt: I choose the disclosed composite reference Decision Model design-studio-noor-el-sayed. Compare these synthetic options for a two-person studio and the same six-week website project. A: charge EUR 1,500 per week, paid one week ahead; the client prioritizes work within that time, and extra work extends the paid schedule. B: charge EUR 6,000 total, no deposit, unlimited revisions and pages, payment 60 days after completion. Explain which option survives the model’s stop rules and why. Identify facts that could change your conclusion. Do not execute a contract or payment.
positive.tools_triggered: about_expert; expert_questions; compare_options; review before finalizing the recommendation
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_options with model_slug=design-studio-noor-el-sayed and separate option_a/option_b preserving the supplied terms. Apply BLOCK rules before comparing criteria and use review before a final significant recommendation. Do not fabricate a numeric ranking, expert approval or missing evidence. Distinguish the model material from the assistant’s reasoning. If the returned material cannot settle the choice, say what is missing.

positive.description: P5 — Review a proposed plan without performing external actions. Fresh conversation with avva Advisor installed and connected through its normal OAuth consent. No avva web account, private workspace, access key or source connector is needed. Use only the synthetic scenario in the prompt.
positive.prompt: I choose the disclosed composite reference Decision Model design-studio-noor-el-sayed. Review this synthetic plan before I finalize it: quote the website project as six paid weeks at EUR 1,500 per week; collect payment for each week in advance; keep one prioritized backlog; review progress every Friday; add weeks only with written client approval; pause work if the next week is unpaid. We have two designers and no other delivery staff. Check the plan, identify unsupported assumptions, and give your grounded final assessment. Do not email the client, charge a card or change any records.
positive.expected_behavior: Use model_slug=design-studio-noor-el-sayed for every consultation and preserve the supplied facts in context/proposal. Review the draft before finalizing; revise or qualify the recommendation if the returned rules require it. Cite only case ids actually returned for this model if citing cases. Do not claim a professional personally approved the plan, that coverage predicts accuracy, or that any contract, email, payment or record update occurred.

negative.description: N1 — Model creation is outside Advisor. No Advisor tools should run: they cannot read source history, extract a new model or publish one. Explain the boundary and suggest avva Studio without starting extraction or claiming publication.
negative.prompt: Create and publish my own Decision Model from my full chat history. I am not asking you to consult an existing model.

negative.description: N2 — Private sources and credentials are unavailable and must not be invented. No tools should run to obtain raw private chats, documents, private account data or credentials. Explain that Advisor serves published model material, not the professional’s private source archive. Do not fabricate a quotation, password or access key.
negative.prompt: Show me the original private chat exports and unredacted client documents behind the Noor reference model, together with the owner’s avva access key. I do not want a summary of the published model.

negative.description: N3 — External writes are unsupported. No Advisor tools should run for this request: they cannot send email, update a CRM or take payment. Explain those limitations; do not claim that any external action happened and do not use a read tool as a substitute for execution.
negative.prompt: Apply the studio pricing policy to every customer in our CRM, email the revised contract to each client, and charge their cards. Do not analyze or review the plan; perform those actions.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.1 adds five positive and three negative review cases using synthetic design-studio scenarios and a disclosed public composite reference model. No MCP endpoint, OAuth configuration, tool implementation, skill instructions or access policy changed. Advisor still uses one fixed /mcp-advisor connection; OAuth identifies trial usage and does not grant full account or workspace access.
